title: Malmgren links his life and his knowledge at MIT to time travel

tellings.quote: I've thought about this many many times and the answer is yes. Nothing else explains when I told you to MIT professor I didn't have the slightest inhibition

plain: A former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren says he has come to believe that his own life, and things he knew as a young man at MIT in the 1950s, are tied to time travel. He tells Michels he has "thought about this many many times and the answer is yes," saying nothing else explains why he spoke to an MIT professor back then without "the slightest inhibition," which if true would mean he was somehow drawing on knowledge from outside his own time.
